props.description: Viewport edge to attach to; this surface is not anchored to a trigger.

props.name: width
props.description: Existing overlay width preset; geometry is scoped in agent/exceptions.json.

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Modal edge-attached surface for a focused secondary task.
whenToUse: Present a focused task in a modal panel attached to a viewport edge.
whenNotToUse: Persistent nonblocking content: use an application layout region.
Nonblocking feedback: use Alert.
constraints: Modal dialog surface, not a persistent nonblocking sidebar. Use a layout region for persistent adjacent content.

components.name: Sidebar
components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Application sidebar with desktop and compact structures.
whenToUse: Keep navigation persistently in view alongside the main content.
whenNotToUse: Fewer than about five destinations — a horizontal bar reads faster.
Page content or filters that belong in the main column.
constraints: collapsed propagates to SidebarNavigationItem. Application shell owns responsive placement and route state; this is not a mobile drawer.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Set by Sidebar. Hides the label visually while keeping the accessible name.

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Navigation item with Sidebar-owned collapse state.
whenToUse: A single destination within sidebar navigation.
whenNotToUse: Firing an action rather than navigating — use a Button.
constraints: Use inside Sidebar for collapse propagation. active is route state, not a Figma state enum. Supply the actual destination or action appropriate to the exported props.

components.name: Skeleton

props.name: label
props.description: Text for this component's status region; shapes are hidden from assistive technology.

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Loading placeholders for text, avatar rows, cards, and table rows.
whenToUse: Hold the shape of content that is loading, so the layout does not jump when it arrives.
whenNotToUse: Waits short enough that it flashes.
Work with a known duration or total — use Progress.
An error or an empty result — those need their own states.
constraints: The component owns a status region; its shapes are aria-hidden. Use one meaningful loading announcement per region rather than duplicating nested announcements.

components.name: Slider
components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Continuous value selection primitive.
whenToUse: Pick from a continuous or coarsely stepped range where the relative position matters more than the exact figure.
whenNotToUse: A precise value the user knows — use a number input.
Ranges so wide that a pixel is worth many units.
Fewer than about five discrete options — use radios or a segmented control.

components.name: Switch
components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Controlled labelled switch for an immediate boolean setting.
whenToUse: An independent boolean setting that takes effect immediately.
whenNotToUse: A choice applied after Save or submit: use Checkbox.
Exclusive options: use RadioGroup. An action command: use Button.
constraints: Use checked and onCheckedChange. This is the interactive labelled control; SwitchRoot is only its visual track.

components.name: Switch / Root

props.name: state
props.description: Visual preview state only; does not implement interaction or semantics.

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Decorative switch track with visual state previews.
whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer Switch for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use Switch.
constraints: Visual span only, not a focusable switch. The state enum previews appearance, not independent runtime conditions.

components.name: Switch / Thumb
components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Movable Switch thumb.
whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer Switch for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use Switch.
constraints: Visual thumb only. Match the size of its track; no keyboard or pointer behavior is provided.

components.name: Table
components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Jake UI extension for structured tabular data with compact and comfortable density variants plus optional selected-row treatment.
whenToUse: Present records across shared columns, for comparison, scanning, or exact reading.
whenNotToUse: Page layout — use a grid.
A handful of key-value pairs — use a description list.
constraints: Use native thead/tbody/tfoot with TableRow, TableHead and TableCell; TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter are not exported components. Table density propagates to rows.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible action name that identifies the row or task context.

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Icon-only row-action trigger used with Dropdown Menu.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Supply a context-specific label and onClick. This button does not anchor a menu by itself; DropdownMenuTrigger provides controls/id pairing for anchored menus.

components.name: Table / Caption

whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Place first inside the native table, before thead/tbody. Use either Table.caption or one TableCaption child, not both.

As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.

components.name: Table / Container

components.name: Tabs

supportingTypes.name: TabItem

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Grouped navigation for switching between peer views without leaving the current context.
whenToUse: Switch between peer views of the same subject, within one context.
whenNotToUse: Steps in a sequence — use an application-owned sequence with explicit current-step semantics.
Content the reader needs to compare side by side, or to find with the browser's search.
Navigating to a different page — use links.
constraints: Complete controlled tablist and panels. Supply items, selectedId and onSelect; the component composes SegmentedTab and owns group keyboard navigation.

components.name: Textarea

props.name: value
props.description: Current field value. Renders in `--foreground`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when `value` is empty. Renders in `--muted-foreground` (code-only state — no Figma variant).

props.name: helper
props.description: Helper text below the field. Figma property `Helper#82:14`.

props.name: rows
props.description: Initial visible height in lines. Code-only — see the sizing policy below.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit. When set, a counter is rendered and linked via `aria-describedby`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Applies the error border. Independent of `disabled`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Standalone invalid controls need an error message. Inside Field, pass it to Field only.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks input. Independent of `invalid`.

props.name: id
props.description: Ties the field to its `<label>`. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required only when no visible `<label>` exists.

components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Multiline text input for longer freeform content.
whenToUse: Collect free-form text long enough to need more than one line.
whenNotToUse: A single short value — use Input.
Rich or formatted content — use a rich-text editor, not a plain textarea.
constraints: Controlled: supply value and onChange. Use Field for label and validation wiring.
rows sets a fixed editing viewport; long content scrolls and user resizing is disabled. maxLength adds a described character counter, not a per-keystroke live announcement.

components.summary: Two-state action button for formatting, view controls, or other reversible selections.
whenToUse: A reversible on/off action that takes effect immediately — bold, mute, pin, show grid.

whenNotToUse: A form value that is only applied on Save — use Checkbox or RadioGroup.
One-of-many where the options are the data, not actions — use RadioGroup.
A one-way action that cannot be un-done — use a Button.

components.name: Tooltip
components.status: implemented; see verification report for tested scope
components.summary: Optional noninteractive explanation on hover or focus.
whenToUse: Clarify an already named control with short, nonessential text.
whenNotToUse: A control's only accessible name or essential instructions: provide a label or visible text.
Interactive content: use Popover.
constraints: Noninteractive, nonessential text only. Trigger must forward events/ref and have its own accessible name. For interactive content use Popover; for a disabled button place guidance on a focusable wrapper or show it inline.
